title: The MLX engine (--backend mlx) on a Mac: the served default's gates at 4, 6 and 8 bits against the FP8 records
hardware: Apple M5 Pro, 64 GB unified memory (one Mac)

code.note: the engine files every gate run loaded are byte for byte those of the commit

rebased.check: 6-bit: serving gates pass (G2 bit for bit); the 1,400 suite answers bit-identical to the gated run, 1,400 of 1,400

rebased.onto: f2d936e (--describe-options, off by default); the PR's base is 877a431, which changes no source file (REUSE compliance)
rebased.check: 6-bit, on the PR's code: serving gates pass (G2 bit for bit); the 1,400 suite answers bit-identical to the gated run, 1,400 of 1,400

rebased.onto: c6a4847 (#38: --multi-question sequential and --describe-options on are the served defaults); the merged source (merge f3c5026) is identical to this checked code in src/, tests/, pyproject.toml and uv.lock
rebased.check: 6-bit, with the new defaults (describe_options on): serving gates pass (G2 bit for bit); the 1,400 suite answers bit-identical to the gated run, 1,400 of 1,400. No suite or round-12 item carries an option description, so the new rendering default changes none of their prompts; --multi-question does not apply to the MLX engine

models.tokenizer: Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B @ 995ad96 (tokenizer files identical to Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8; tokenizer.json sha256 5f9e4d4901a92b997e463c1f46055088b6cca5ca61a6522d1b9f64c4bb81cb42)

servers: python -m decisio.serve.vllm_engine --backend mlx --model <snapshot> --tokenizer <official tokenizer> --debug-readout --port 23456 (every other flag the served default: front padding to 1,056, T = 1.307, tasks, abstention, the head from the same forward)
reference: runs/2026-09-30_plugin-verification (FP8 served default, server H): conformance_H.json.gz C4 rows for the suite; intent_heads/ for the heads
pre_registration: private RLCD experiment 2026-10-02_t2_mlx_backend (PLAN.md, PREREG.md), written before any gate measurement; G1 reported, not gated, for the reason stated there
excluded: the registrations' example hidden states (r12/*_examples.npz, 83 MB) and the server logs: kept in the private record
the 1,400 suite items and the round-12 items: private (RLCD); the records here carry answers, labels and probabilities, no item text
cost: this Mac's time only (16 h of wall clock for the chain)
deviations: the 8-bit memory stage failed on a code error in the memory script (JSON-object states joined as text) and ran after the chain with the fixed script; no number was produced before the fix
the idle rule for latency was not met at any quantisation; the third pass is reported with its load (latency.json)
decisions: Amin, 2026-10-02: 6-bit is the Mac default; 4-bit the documented option for 32 GB machines; 8-bit not shipped, its ECE miss reported as pre-registered

pad_policy_shared.decision: Amin, 2026-10-02: gate --pad-policy shared on the MLX backend at 6 bits with the backend's full gate set; if it passes, make it the MLX default. It passed, and is the MLX default (resolve_pad_policy)
pad_policy_shared.code: decisio f3c5026 (as merged), --pad-policy shared; records in 6bit_shared/
pad_policy_shared.pre_registration: private RLCD experiment 2026-10-02_t2_mlx_backend, PREREG.md addendum A, written before the run

gates.P_prompts: 1,400 of 1,400 single-question rows equal the default rows minus their front padding; multi-question rows unchanged
gates.C1_cpu_and_G2: pass (16 fillers and repeat bit for bit); a question alone vs inside a request differs by design: max 0.021, 0 flips (reported)
gates.H3_reported: a head question inside a two-question (padded) request: BANKING77 0.840 and CLINC150 0.920, 0 items changed against the same draw served alone

pad_policy_shared.superseded_by: pad_policy_none: no padding gated and adopted as the MLX default instead (Amin, 2026-10-02)

pad_policy_none.decision: Amin, 2026-10-02: gate no padding on MLX at 6 bits with the shared run's gate set plus the alone-vs-in-request check bit for bit and H3; if it passes, it replaces shared as the MLX default. It passed
pad_policy_none.code: decisio f3c5026 (as merged), --pad-to none (the rows --pad-policy none builds); records in 6bit_none/
pad_policy_none.pre_registration: private RLCD experiment 2026-10-02_t2_mlx_backend, PREREG.md addendum C, written before the run

gates.P_prompts: 1,400 of 1,400 suite rows and the multi-question rows equal the default rows minus their front padding
gates.C1_cpu_and_G2: pass: 16 fillers, repeat, and each question alone against inside the request, all bit for bit
gates.suite_bit_identical_to_shared: 1,400 of 1,400 (single-question prompts are the same under shared and none)

pad_policy_none.latency_note: every pass ran beside heavy foreign load (up to 265% CPU) and the passes differed by up to 2.6x; the multi-question cells are not a measurement of the policy
